options.name: api_host
options.description: The URL to the Datadog API. This value can also be set with the E(DATADOG_HOST) environment variable.

options.name: downtime_message
options.description: A message to include with notifications for this downtime. Email notifications can be sent to specific users by using the same "@username" notation as events.

options.name: end
options.description: POSIX timestamp to end the downtime. If not provided, the downtime is in effect until you cancel it.

options.name: id
options.description: The identifier of the downtime. If empty, a new downtime gets created, otherwise it is either updated or deleted depending of the O(state). To keep your playbook idempotent, you should save the identifier in a file and read it in a lookup.

options.name: monitor_id
options.description: The ID of the monitor to mute. If not provided, the downtime applies to all monitors.

options.name: monitor_tags
options.description: A list of monitor tags to which the downtime applies. The resulting downtime applies to monitors that match ALL provided monitor tags.

options.name: rrule
options.description: The C(RRULE) standard for defining recurring events. For example, to have a recurring event on the first day of each month, select a type of rrule and set the C(FREQ) to C(MONTHLY) and C(BYMONTHDAY) to C(1). Most common rrule options from the iCalendar Spec are supported. Attributes specifying the duration in C(RRULE) are not supported (for example C(DTSTART), C(DTEND), C(DURATION)).

options.name: scope
options.description: A list of scopes to which the downtime applies. The resulting downtime applies to sources that matches ALL provided scopes.

options.name: start
options.description: POSIX timestamp to start the downtime. If not provided, the downtime starts the moment it is created.

options.name: state
options.description: The designated state of the downtime.
